q.t: Carbohydrates are mainly…
q.e: Carbs (and fats) give energy.

q.t: Proteins are mainly…
q.e: Proteins help growth and repair.

q.t: Vitamins and minerals are…
q.e: They protect against disease.

q.t: Which test shows starch?
q.e: Iodine + starch = blue-black.

q.t: Which test shows fat?
q.e: Fat leaves a translucent oily patch.

q.t: Which test shows protein?
o: Violet colour with copper sulfate and caustic soda
q.e: Protein turns violet.

q.t: Scurvy is caused by lack of…
q.e: Bleeding gums and slow healing.

q.t: Night blindness is caused by lack of…
q.e: Carrots, papaya and mango supply vitamin A.

q.t: Goitre is caused by lack of…
q.e: Swelling at the front of the neck; iodised salt prevents it.

q.t: Anaemia is caused by lack of…
q.e: Weakness and shortness of breath.

q.t: Rickets (soft, bent bones) is caused by lack of…
q.e: Sunlight helps the body make vitamin D.

q.t: Beriberi is caused by lack of…
q.e: Swelling and tingling in hands and feet.

q.t: Which vitamin can the body make with sunlight?
q.e: Vitamin D is special.

q.t: Why does a marathon runner drink glucose water?
q.e: Glucose is quickly used for energy.

q.t: Peanuts test positive for…
q.e: One food can contain several nutrients.

q.t: Roughage helps by…
q.e: It gives no nutrients but helps stools pass smoothly.

q.t: A balanced diet contains…
o: All nutrients, roughage and water in the right amounts
q.e: Right amounts for proper growth.

q.t: Junk food is high in…
q.e: But very low in proteins, vitamins, minerals and fibre.

q.t: Traditional food of a state is usually based on…
q.e: Different soils and climates grow different crops.

q.t: Salt comes from…
q.e: It comes from neither plants nor animals.

q.t: Why are laddoos with ghee and nuts eaten in winter?
o: Fat gives energy that keeps you warm
q.e: Fat is stored energy.

q.t: How did James Lind help sailors with scurvy (1746)?
o: Noticed lemons and oranges cured them
q.e: Citrus supplies the missing vitamin C.

q.t: Why was goitre common in the Himalayan region?
o: Iodine was missing from the soil, food and water
q.e: Iodised salt reduced the problem.

q.t: Why should fruit be washed before cutting, not after?
q.e: Cut pieces lose some vitamins in water.

q.t: Why include uncooked vegetables and fruits?
o: Cooking at high heat destroys some vitamin C
q.e: Some nutrients are lost with heat.

q.t: Per 100 g, roasted chana compared with potato wafers has…
o: Less fat, more protein and more fibre
q.e: Chana: 6.26 g fat, 18.64 g protein, 16.8 g fibre. Wafers: 35 g fat, 7 g protein, 4.8 g fibre.

q.t: Why do you and your grandparents need different diets?
o: Needs vary with age, activity and health
q.e: Requirements depend on age, gender, activity, health and lifestyle.

q.t: Polar bears survive winter sleep without eating because of…
o: A thick layer of stored fat
q.e: Fat is stored energy for hibernation.

q.t: Why must you not touch copper sulfate and caustic soda?
q.e: If spilled, wash immediately with water.

q.t: Chulha → gas stove and sil-batta → electric grinder happened because of…
q.e: Culinary practices changed with development.

q.t: How many times more fibre does roasted chana have than potato wafers (16.8 vs 4.8)?
q.e: 16.8 ÷ 4.8 = 3.5 — over three times the fibre.

q.t: A child has bleeding gums and wounds that heal slowly. Which food helps most?
q.e: Symptoms of scurvy — vitamin C is needed.

q.t: A child has soft, bent bones. Which helps?
q.e: Rickets — vitamin D from sunlight and food.

q.t: A food gives a violet colour and an oily patch. It contains…
q.e: Violet = protein; oily patch = fat.

q.t: What does water do in the body?
o: Helps absorb nutrients and remove waste
q.e: Water removes waste through sweat and urine.

q.t: Who analysed over 500 Indian foods for nutrition?
q.e: His work led to the Mid Day Meal Programme, now PM POSHAN.

q.t: Frequent junk food can lead to…
q.e: High calories with few nutrients.

q.t: Which is a plant source of protein?
q.e: Pulses, beans, peas, nuts, soya and mushrooms.

q.t: Why is locally grown, plant-based food recommended?
o: Good for the body and the environment
q.e: Less transport and nourishing food.

q.t: Punjab's makki di roti and sarson da saag are made from…
o: Maize and mustard greens grown there
q.e: Traditional food follows local crops.
